References / Editorial / 528

Riso zine page, “stuck indoors 2”

A zine page about VHS films, printed in fluorescent pink and blue: collage, text, and drawing on separate layers that overprint into violet and do not quite align.

Source
Flickr: themostinept, “7th June 2020”
Creator
Unknown. The Flickr uploader, themostinept, does not say who made the zine.
Made
by 2020 (photographed 7 June 2020)
Style
Risograph (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Handmade, indie, layered
Evidence
Viewed the 704 × 1024 px Flickr “large” file, a phone photograph of one page. The Flickr description is “stuck indoors 2”. The zine’s title and maker are not stated.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Posted on Flickr under CC BY-SA 2.0 by themostinept. It is not clear that the uploader made the zine, so the rights of the printed work are unknown.

Observed

  • The page uses fluorescent pink and a mid blue on off-white paper, and no black.
  • A pink rectangle with the word “VHS” sits under a blue drawing of a VHS case and a deer. Where they cross, the color is violet.
  • Blue text bars at the top are knocked out of the ink, and the pink layer sits a few millimeters off from the blue.
  • Blue areas are grainy and uneven, with streaks in the large photographic areas.

Why it belongs

The page shows nearly every riso trait at once: two inks, overprint mixing, grain, and misregistration, used for a personal, collaged zine.

Borrow

Put text in knocked-out bars of a single ink, and let a second ink block run under it slightly off register.

A growing catalogue of visual references. Rights and removal
